sources.title: Hino City Council: 令和8年第3回定例会 一般質問通告一覧表 (notified general questions, third regular session 2026)
sources.capture_note: Captured 27 October 2026 (25,594 bytes); page ID 1031866, 更新日 27 August 2026. Reached from the council's top page (一般質問一覧表). www.city.hino.lg.jp robots.txt (HTTP 200) was read and recorded before the first request; it disallows /shisei/koukokushiki/ (public notices), /kohohino/backnumber/ and CGI paths, none of which was requested or used. Councillors' names on the page are not copied; HTTP Last-Modified only reflects page regeneration (27 October 2026) and is not used. An Internet Archive availability check answered HTTP 429 and was not retried.
sources.summary: The council's list of general questions notified for its third regular session of 2026 (session 1 September to 7 October 2026; questions on 1, 2 and 5 to 7 October). It includes, for 5 October, a question titled '三井不動産日野台データセンター建設は一時凍結を！環境アセスを実施させよ！' (calling for Mitsui Fudosan's Hino-dai data-centre construction to be frozen and an environmental assessment to be required), and for 7 October '日野台データセンター造成工事10月着工を許さない' (opposing the start of the Hino-dai data centre's site-grading works in October), together with questions on large data centres generally ('巨大データセンターの弊害から市民を守るために、法整備・条例制定を急げ！') and on residents' petitions about large data-centre construction. It is a council record that names the Mitsui Fudosan Hino-dai data-centre plan as a current plan with site-grading works scheduled for October 2026; the question texts are councillors' positions, not findings, and the page records no answers.
sources.date_semantics: Page 更新日 27 August 2026. The session schedule (jp-kanto-pref-p5-hino-council-schedule-r8-3, 更新日 1 July 2026) sets the session's announcement day as 25 August 2026, the opening as 1 September and the general questions as 1 to 7 October 2026, so a notice list for this session can only date from about the announcement day and before the questions; 27 August is consistent with both. 27 August 2026 is used as the date on which the council record identifies the plan (announced). The October 2026 grading start is a planned date taken from the question title, not an observation of works. Verifier corroboration (27 October 2026): the Internet Archive copy of the council top page of 10 October 2026 (web.archive.org/web/20261010021433id_/https://www.city.hino.lg.jp/shigikai/index.html; local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/ia-20261010-hino-shigikai-index.html, decoded sha256 d55588a5..., byte-identical to the 27 October live capture) lists this notice list in its new-information feed under 8月27日（木曜日）, after the 10 August entry and before the 28 August entry, with no later update entry for it; the 9 August 2026 archive copy of that page (ia-20260809-hino-shigikai-index.html, sha256 61576a9a...; feed tops out at 4 August) does not list it. The 27 August date is therefore bounded by an archived copy, and the list was public no later than 10 October 2026. No archive copy of the notice list itself exists (CDX listing empty).

sources.capture_note: Captured 27 October 2026 (30,721 bytes); page ID 1031867, 更新日 30 September 2026; the council's top page lists it as updated with the 29 September results. www.city.hino.lg.jp robots.txt (HTTP 200) was read and recorded before the first request; it disallows /shisei/koukokushiki/ (public notices), /kohohino/backnumber/ and CGI paths, none of which was requested or used.
sources.summary: Results table of the third regular session of 2026. It records that petition 請願第8－7号, '重要な環境データも安全対策も示されないデータセンターの工事着工の延期を求める請願' (asking for the start of construction of a data centre, for which key environmental data and safety measures had not been shown, to be postponed), was rejected (不採択) on 29 September 2026, with the votes of each council group. The petition title does not name the plan; in Hino the only data-centre plan in council and city records is the Mitsui Fudosan Hino-dai plan, whose site-grading start in October 2026 is the subject of the notified general questions.
sources.date_semantics: Page 更新日 30 September 2026; the petition decision is dated 29 September 2026 in the table. Identity and successor context only: it shows the construction-start dispute was live on 29 September and that the council did not ask for postponement. It is not a permit, a works observation or an independent identification of the site.

sources.summary: Developer material dated 2026.7.9 for the (仮称)日野市日野台3丁目計画, proponent (事業者) Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. Site: 日野市日野台3丁目1番32,33,34の一部 and 日野台4丁目31番1,2,5, the former Hino Motors west plant (日野自動車旧西側工場跡地), 114,037.24 m2, industrial zone with a first-class low-rise residential strip on the west. It states that a data centre is to be developed on the former plant site in line with the city's master plan and innovation vision, and its development overview (page 8) shows the site outline with three planned buildings (計画建物①-③, each 143 m by 91 m), a 6,920 m2 park on the north side, buffer greenery, a development road and entrances on 甲州街道. All figures are marked as current plans subject to change.
sources.date_semantics: Dated 2026.7.9 (meeting day); the posting day is not stated (the council page was updated 5 August 2026), so no publication date is recorded. Used for identity, plan description and the locator only, not as the status observation.
